65175a063b23aa83.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تتبع الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتشخيص الأعطال، وتقدير التكاليف، ومتابعة أنشطة الصيانة لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل الدورية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في صيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الإلكترونية. معرفة قوية بأساليب تشخيص الأعطال الإلكترونية وتحديد أسبابها. متطلبات إضافية القدرة على تقدير كمية وكلفة المواد والمستلزمات المطلوبة للصيانة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد وتقديم التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمل الأجهزة الإلكترونية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6528ab98d1c45e67.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الامواج الماسية للتجارة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. الموقع جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المقابلة والمؤهلات.

653058174bc0f7f9.description: About the Role The اللجنة الوطنية لرعاية السجناء والمفرج عنهم وأسرهم is seeking a Corporate Excellence Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for leading corporate excellence initiatives by enhancing performance standards, driving continuous improvement, and developing robust quality systems, policies, and procedures. The manager will also promote innovation and governance to support the achievement of strategic objectives and enhance the committee’s competitiveness. Key Responsibilities The Corporate Excellence Manager will oversee both administrative and specialized tasks to ensure the effective implementation of corporate excellence frameworks. Participate in developing administrative policies, initiatives, and operational plans, including setting primary goals, target values, and KPIs, and continuously measuring and tracking them. Contribute to achieving core objectives, guiding the team to enhance service quality, accuracy, and effectiveness. Propose workflow and procedural improvements, ensuring all approved work systems, policies, and procedures are thoroughly documented and adhered to. Monitor, follow up, and evaluate employee performance, identify training needs, recommend necessary training courses, and assess their outcomes and effectiveness. Estimate, identify, and provide all necessary resources, materials, and technologies for daily operations, ensuring optimal and effective utilization. Collaborate in setting the department’s budget with relevant departments and monitor its financial performance. Identify talent and competence needs, and make recommendations regarding human resources decisions (rewards, hiring, promotions, and transfers) in coordination with relevant organizational units. Establish effective communication channels with staff and maintain ongoing engagement regarding updates and decisions. Organize and archive department documents for easy retrieval and utilization. Monitor the provision of administrative resources, equipment, and materials in coordination with specialized units. Prepare periodic reports on departmental achievements and development proposals for the direct manager. Specialized Tasks Supervise the development of the annual corporate excellence plan, including preparing, implementing, evaluating, and periodically reviewing its programs and initiatives. Oversee the establishment of corporate excellence standards in line with requirements and best practices and ensure their dissemination. Monitor compliance with approved corporate excellence standards, track non-compliance cases, and determine corrective actions. Prepare corporate excellence reports, including analyses, benchmarking, and supportive recommendations for performance and quality development. Implement institutional development initiatives and measure their impact on operational efficiency and sustainable improvement. Review and document processes according to continuous improvement methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and standardize procedures. Foster a culture of excellence and provide support to organizational units to achieve corporate excellence. Perform any other assigned tasks within the scope of the position. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess between 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience. Specific qualifications were not provided. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within the اللجنة الوطنية لرعاية السجناء والمفرج عنهم وأسرهم, contributing to its strategic objectives through corporate excellence initiatives. Application Process Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

6556d72e0d266efc.description: About the Role Westin is seeking a Cook to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The role involves preparing and cooking food items according to established recipes and quality standards, ensuring a high level of food preparation and presentation. Key Responsibilities Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food items. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables, and accurately weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Cook and prepare food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items and operate kitchen equipment such as ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to ensure sufficient cooking and monitor food quality throughout the preparation process. Set up and break down work stations, and serve food in proper portions using appropriate receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen areas, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of appliance and food temperatures. Safety and Operational Compliance Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Teamwork and Professional Conduct Communicate with colleagues using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with team members. Support the team in achieving common goals and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support kitchen operations and service delivery.

657b29f959338628.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خالد سليم الأحمدي للمقاولات عن مهندس طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. يركز الدور على إجراء الدراسات الفنية لمشاريع إنشاء الطرق، وتحديد المسارات المثلى، وإعداد التصاميم الهندسية، ومتابعة التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الصور الجوية والمخططات الطبوغرافية والتقارير المائية والجيولوجية والبيئية المتعلقة بمشاريع الطرق، وتقييم بدائل المسارات لاختيار الأنسب. إعداد التصاميم الأولية وتحديد مواقع الجسور والعبارات واتجاهاتها وسعاتها، بالإضافة إلى تحديد مواقع الجدران الاستنادية على جوانب الطريق. دراسة المواد المتوفرة وتحديد خصائصها، واختيار الأنسب منها لطبقات الرصف، وتصميم طبقات الرصف وتحديد أنواعها وسماكتها ومكوناتها. متابعة تنفيذ مشاريع الطرق لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال هندسة الطرق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة الطرق. فهم عميق للدراسات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الطرق وتصميمها. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات المواد المستخدمة في طبقات الرصف. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع البنية التحتية للطرق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة خالد سليم الأحمدي للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

65889af19896d842.description: About the Role Big Blue Diamond Co. is seeking an HR Officer Saudi to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is integral to managing human resources processes within the accounting industry, supporting business objectives through efficient HR operations. The HR Officer will contribute to fostering a positive workplace culture and enhancing employee engagement. Role Contribution The HR Officer will collaborate with various departments to align HR strategies with business goals. This position involves developing and implementing HR best practices, with a focus on recruitment, onboarding, and employee development programs. The role offers opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibilities in shaping HR strategy. Key Responsibilities Manage the recruitment process, including collaborating with department heads, crafting job descriptions, and sourcing candidates to ensure a diverse talent pool. Implement onboarding programs to integrate new hires into the company culture and provide necessary tools for success. Conduct employee performance reviews, providing feedback and identifying areas for professional development. Administer employee benefits programs, ensuring compliance and assisting with employee inquiries. 65d851064a643239.description: About the Role Sunbulah Group is seeking a Supply Chain Planner to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on both commercial planning and demand forecasting within the supply chain. Key Responsibilities: Commercial Planning Extract consolidated sales forecasts for commercial products from the system. Review monthly forecasts with the sales department, covering both local and export sales. Issue bi-weekly commercial planning reports. Identify purchasing needs for commercial products. Prepare and present long-term planning to the commercial buying manager for contract preparation (*, crop-to-crop). Generate Request for Quotations (RFQs) in the system for approved suppliers, coordinating with the Commercial Buying Manager. Create necessary Purchase Orders (POs) and contracts for suppliers within their specified lead times. Follow up on PO releases with relevant managers. Obtain supplier confirmation on delivery dates and maintain accurate records. Coordinate with the commercial buying manager regarding suppliers and pricing of commercial products. Liaise with the warehouse for product deliveries. Coordinate with the logistics division for document handover and customs clearance. Issue required reports and planning sheets in a timely manner. Maintain a proper filing and record system. Key Responsibilities: Demand Planning Prepare daily demand and supply availability reports and activities. Prepare monthly MBR and DMR data to ensure a complete Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle is met on time. Prepare and monitor statistical forecasts for local markets. Manage and maintain KPIs for Finished Goods (FG) availability tracking on a daily and monthly basis across all plants. Manage and maintain KPIs for company forecast accuracy reporting monthly for all markets. Evaluate and recommend actions to improve on-time supply performance. Follow up with supply team members to ensure timely delivery of required volumes. Measure delivery team performance against company guidelines and department KPIs, issuing monthly reports to the delivery team and their line managers for accountability. Maintain a library of historical data and key learnings from previous months' performance, making data available as needed. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, processes, and practices, considering best practices and business process enhancements. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

6524af889642cda7.description: About Albawani Holding Albawani is a leading construction and contracting company in Saudi Arabia, established in 1991. Headquartered in Riyadh, the company has grown into a diversified group with operations spanning construction, infrastructure, engineering, water and power, and industrial services. Albawani is recognized for delivering large-scale commercial, healthcare, educational, and government projects across the Kingdom, maintaining a strong commitment to quality, safety, and innovation. The Role of Data Infrastructure Supervisor Albawani Holding is seeking a Data Infrastructure Supervisor to join the Group Digital IT and Technology Department in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience. The supervisor will lead a technical team of data engineers, analysts, and external consultants to manage a robust data infrastructure using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. The role supports enterprise machine learning/AI initiatives, enforces data governance, and delivers actionable insights to drive strategic decision-making across all group subsidiaries. Key Responsibilities Assign daily work, track deliverables, provide technical mentorship, conduct performance reviews, and foster skill development within the team. Oversee ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion into Microsoft Fabric, ensuring data quality and security, optimizing pipeline performance, and managing workspaces. Manage Power BI workspaces and access controls, support interactive dashboard development, and assist subsidiaries with analytics best practices. Coordinate ML model deployments, integrate predictive outputs into operational workflows, and champion generative AI tools such as Copilot. Liaise with internal business units and external vendors, monitor cloud resource consumption and costs for back charging, and drive efficiency improvements. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in data infrastructure management and team leadership. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Group Digital IT and Technology Department of Albawani Holding. The role involves leading a technical team and collaborating with various internal business units and external partners.

Contribute to stakeholder mapping, including segmentation and profiling, and provide accurate and timely data for the Alcon CRM system. Establish and implement a sales/business plan for a designated client base. 65930ffa6486cbfd.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Food and Beverage Supervisor to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. 65064d641fce02a4.description: About the Role: Paper Machine Operator Careers International is seeking a Paper Machine Operator to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for the efficient and safe operation of the paper machine, ensuring the production of high-quality paper products that meet or exceed customer and regulatory requirements. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor and adjust the paper machine's operating parameters, including speed, temperature, and chemical dosing, to maintain product quality and process efficiency. Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance on the paper machine and associated equipment, identifying and reporting any issues or malfunctions. Coordinate with the production team to ensure the timely and orderly supply of raw materials, chemicals, and other consumables required for paper production. Collect and analyze data from the paper machine's control systems and instrumentation, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance. Implement quality control measures, such as sampling and testing, to ensure the final paper product meets all specified requirements. Document all relevant operational data, production logs, and quality records in accordance with company policies and regulatory standards. Assist with the troubleshooting and resolution of any production-related issues, collaborating with maintenance and engineering personnel as needed. Adhere to all safety protocols and environmental regulations pertaining to the operation of the paper machine and associated processes. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing productivity, efficiency, and product quality. Provide training and mentorship to less experienced paper machine operators, as required. Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in paper machine operations. Thorough understanding of paper machine operations, process control systems, and quality control procedures. Proficient in interpreting and adjusting process parameters based on real-time data and production requirements. Familiarity with safety protocols and environmental regulations in the paper manufacturing industry. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on the operational aspects of paper production within a manufacturing setting.

657633c713612b2a.description: About the Role Penspen is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer-Rotating to join its engineering team. This full-time position is based in Al Khafji, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia, and will focus on a major Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) project. The role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, specifically with rotating equipment. Role Context The Senior Mechanical Engineer-Rotating will lead engineering activities for rotating equipment across various project phases. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco standards and prior experience in major brownfield FEED/EPC projects will be considered an advantage for this role. Key Responsibilities Lead rotating equipment engineering activities for FEED, detailed design, and EPC phases of oil & gas projects. Develop data sheets, specifications, and requisitions for rotating equipment, including compressors, pumps, turbines, blowers, and packaged systems. Review vendor offers, perform technical bid evaluations, and participate in vendor meetings and design reviews. Ensure compliance with API, ASME, ISO, and other relevant international standards. Coordinate with process, piping, instrumentation, and electrical disciplines for equipment integration. Review vendor documents (GA drawings, datasheets, performance curves, etc.) and ensure timely approval. Provide technical support during procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning phases. Participate in HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and design review workshops. 657aed96f36ec84f.description: About CPECC: China Petroleum Engineering & Construction Corp (CPECC) is a leading EPC contractor in the oil & gas industry, delivering world-class pipeline, processing, and infrastructure projects across the Middle East and globally. Position: Electrical Engineer Project: Oil & Gas EPC Pipeline Projects (Saudi Arabia) Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Job Responsibilities: - Lead electrical engineering and field installation activities for oil & gas EPC projects. - Review and approve electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, and equipment layouts. - Supervise installation and commissioning of HV/LV switchgear, transformers, MCC panels, and motors. - Manage cable pulling, termination, and electrical testing activities. - Coordinate with instrumentation, piping, and civil teams for integrated execution. - Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco electrical standards (SAES-P series), IEC, and NEC codes. - Conduct pre-commissioning, energization, and functional testing of electrical systems. - Interface with Saudi Aramco inspection and commissioning teams. - Lead and mentor electrical supervisors, foremen, and technicians. Requirements: - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. - 10+ years of hands-on experience in electrical construction and installation for oil & gas EPC projects. - Proven experience on Saudi Aramco projects is a strong advantage. - Proficient in Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES-P), IEC 60364, IEEE. - Strong experience with HV/LV power systems, earthing, lighting, and cathodic protection. - Familiar with hazardous area classification (ATEX/IECEx) requirements. - Ability to read single-line diagrams, cable schedules, and electrical drawings. - Strong leadership, coordination, and technical problem-solving skills. - Fluent in English; Arabic or Chinese is a plus. - Valid Saudi Iqama or willingness to relocate to Saudi Arabia. What We Offer: - Competitive expat salary package. - Accommodation, transportation, and medical benefits provided. - Opportunity to work on landmark Saudi Arabia energy infrastructure projects. - Career growth within a global EPC organization.

654c5638378c9fab.description: Eram Talent is excited to announce an opening for a Quality System Auditor to join our team in Saudi Arabia. Our organization is committed to connecting skilled professionals with leading companies that prioritize quality and excellence in their operations. The Quality System Auditor will be responsible for performing comprehensive audits of quality management systems to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies. The ideal candidate will possess a keen eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and a thorough understanding of quality assurance principles. Responsibilities Conduct audits of quality management systems to assess compliance with applicable regulations and quality standards Develop and implement audit plans and methodologies tailored to specific projects Analyze audit findings and prepare detailed reports outlining results, recommendations, and areas for improvement Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement corrective actions and ensure effective quality management Provide training and support to staff regarding quality standards and auditing processes Monitor and review quality management processes and recommend enhancements Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in quality management Required Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in quality auditing, with a focus on quality management systems Required Skills: In-depth knowledge of quality management systems standards (e.g., ISO 9001) Strong analytical and critical thinking skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, or a related field Certification as an ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or equivalent Preferred Qualifications: Experience in the manufacturing or engineering sector Familiarity with other quality standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001) is desirable
